Our Plan for Sponsorship Money

Robot parts and materials

We plan to purchase GoBilda parts and components for the robot construction.

Competition costs

The sponsorship money will be used to register for competitions and host scrimmages with other school teams.

Team attire

We will create and buy team uniforms.

What your support helps provide

Sponsorship money helps us build a stronger and more competitive robot using higher-quality parts and materials, while also allowing us to host more scrimmages. The support is truly appreciated and invaluable to the team.

Every contribution makes a difference.
